lines.en: label bar25:
scene bartwofive1
I decide to spend yet another night at the bar killing time with Sana.
lines.zh: 我决定又去酒吧待一晚，跟 Sana 一起消磨时间。

lines.en: Without me even having to ask, she grabs a beer from the cooler and slides it over to me with an uncharacteristic smile on her face.
lines.zh: 我还没开口，她就已经从冷藏柜里拿了瓶啤酒推到我面前，脸上挂着难得一见的笑容。

lines.en: : In a good mood tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚心情不错？

lines.en: : Hm?
: Why do you ask?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么问？……

lines.en: : You seem a lot less nervous than usual.
lines.zh: : 你看起来没平时那么紧张。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 有吗？

lines.en: : I’m just...a little relieved that my mom isn’t around...That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点庆幸我妈妈不在……就只是这样。

lines.en: : Ahh. Yeah, I can imagine it probably takes a load off of your mind knowing that she can’t show up and randomly embarrass you.
lines.zh: : 啊。是啊，我能想象，知道她不会突然冒出来让你难堪，心里的担子确实轻了不少。

lines.en: scene bartwofive2
: You don’t get the half of it...
lines.zh: : 你才知道一半呢……

lines.en: : It’s only been getting worse lately too...
lines.zh: : 而且最近还越来越严重了……

lines.en: : Really? Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 真的？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene bartwofive3
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 出了。

lines.en: : ...Explain?
lines.zh: : ……解释一下？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} happened.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}就是那件事。

lines.en: : Saying it with that sort of expression makes you seem more like Yumi and less like Sana.
lines.zh: : 你用这种表情说这种话，会让你更像 Yumi 而不是 Sana。

lines.en: : Give me back my favorite bartender.
lines.zh: : 把我最喜欢的酒保还给我。

lines.en: scene bartwofive2
: I’m only kidding...
lines.zh: : 我只是开玩笑啦……

lines.en: : Though...it is true that my mom has been {i}really{/i} annoying ever since you started coming around...
lines.zh: : 不过……自从你开始来这儿，我妈妈确实变得{i}特别{/i}烦人……

lines.en: : She keeps asking me questions about you and...I have no idea how to answer even half of them...
lines.zh: : 她老是不停地问我关于你的问题，而且……有一半我根本不知道该怎么回答……

lines.en: : Well, what kind of questions? Maybe I can help?
lines.zh: : 那么，是些什么问题？也许我帮得上忙？

lines.en: scene bartwofive4
: Huh?...Well...it’s not like I’ve...kept track of them or anything...
lines.zh: : 咦？……嗯……我也没有……特意记下来之类的……

lines.en: : They’re mostly just random things like what kind of food you like or...what you do for fun.
lines.zh: : 大多都是些随口的问题，比如你喜欢吃什么，或者……你平时玩什么。

lines.en: scene bartwofive2
: I think...she thinks we might be closer than we actually are...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……她觉得我们的关系比实际上的更亲密……

lines.en: : Well, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 嗯，难道不是吗？

lines.en: : I like to think that we’ve at least sort of transcended the teacher/student thing by now, right?
lines.zh: : 我愿意认为，我们至少已经多少超越了老师和学生那一层了吧？

lines.en: : Well...I don’t think I’ve ever had another teacher who routinely shows up in my room...so I guess so.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想我从没遇到过另一个会经常出现在我房间里的老师……所以大概是吧。

lines.en: : But I still don’t know much about you either...
lines.zh: : 不过我对你也不太了解……

lines.en: To be fair, even {i}I{/i} don’t know much about myself.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，连{i}我{/i}自己都不太了解我自己。

lines.en: This version of me, at least.
lines.zh: 至少这个版本的我是这样。

lines.en: It’s not like I can just sit down with Ami and ask something like, “Hey, what was I into a couple years ago? How different did I act?”
lines.zh: 我又不可能坐下来跟 Ami 问一句“嘿，我几年前都喜欢些什么？我以前是什么样子的？”

lines.en: It’s a confusing situation.
lines.zh: 这情况挺让人糊涂的。

lines.en: And it definitely doesn’t help that there isn’t really anything I find appealing other than...
lines.zh: 而且除了一件事之外，我也确实找不到什么让我觉得有吸引力的东西，这更是一点忙都帮不上。

lines.en: Well, having conversations with [younger_girls] in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 那就是……在半夜跟[younger_girls]聊天。

lines.en: But hey, at least it feels a little more normal talking to one in a bar rather than a porn shop...
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，至少在酒吧里跟她们说话比在情趣用品店里感觉正常一点……

lines.en: : Well how about this-
lines.zh: : 那么这样如何——

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} have any questions for me, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，{i}你{/i}有什么想问我的吗？

lines.en: scene bartwofive4
: Are you...going to answer them?
lines.zh: : 你……会回答吗？

lines.en: : I believe that was implied, yes.
lines.zh: : 我想这不是明摆着的吗，会。

lines.en: : And...are you going to ask me any?
lines.zh: : 还有……你会问我吗？

lines.en: : ...Do you want me to?
lines.zh: : ……你想让我问？

lines.en: scene bartwofive1
: Sure...We can make it a sort of...game. Or something...
lines.zh: : 当然……我们可以把它弄成一种……游戏。什么的……

lines.en: scene bartwofive5
: Like...we could take turns getting to know more about each other...
lines.zh: : 比如……我们可以轮流去了解彼此……

lines.en: : Something like that might be easier for me since I can’t really...steer conversations myself.
lines.zh: : 那样对我来说可能容易一些，因为我实在不会……自己主导对话。

lines.en: : What’s all this about steering conversations?
lines.zh: : 这个“主导对话”是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene bartwofive6
: Maki?
lines.zh: : Maki？

lines.en: : Yes! That is me. Maki.
lines.zh: : 对！正是在下。Maki。

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Drinking, I hope.
lines.zh: : 喝酒，我希望。

lines.en: scene bartwofive7
: Is your mom around tonight, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，你妈妈今晚在吗？

lines.en: : Huh?...Oh, umm...No. She had plans with a friend tonight.
lines.zh: : 咦？……哦，嗯……不在。她今晚跟朋友有约。

lines.en: : And I wasn’t invited? Damn that tramp.
lines.zh: : 而我居然没被邀请？那个贱人。

lines.en: scene bartwofive2
: Do you know who that woman is?
lines.zh: : 你知道那个女人是谁吗？

lines.en: : Maki! Do I need to say it even louder?
lines.zh: : Maki！要不要我再大声点说一遍？

lines.en: : That’s umm...the...
lines.zh: : 那个是嗯……那个……

lines.en: scene bartwofive5
: That’s the...porn-lady...
lines.zh: : 那个是……色情店大姐姐……

lines.en: scene bartwofive8
Maki walks up to the bar and takes her place on the stool directly beside me.
lines.zh: Maki 走到吧台前，在我正旁边的凳子上坐下。

lines.en: What sort of woman gets dressed up like that to come to the bar all by herself?
lines.zh: 什么样的女人会打扮成那样、一个人来酒吧？

lines.en: She realizes this place doesn't ever have any customers, right?
lines.zh: 她应该知道这地方从来没客人吧？

lines.en: : Porn-lady isn't really the best nickname I could have asked for. But I guess I can take it.
lines.zh: : “色情店大姐姐”实在算不上我期待过的外号。不过我想我还是能接受的。

lines.en: scene bartwofive9
: Heh...Take it.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……接受。

lines.en: : Like a dick.
lines.zh: : 像接受鸡巴一样。

lines.en: : Get it?
lines.zh: : 懂吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Maki. I get it.
lines.zh: : 懂了，Maki。我懂。

lines.en: scene bartwofive10
: Were you two in the middle of something? I could have sworn I overheard a chat about the question-game.
lines.zh: : 你们俩是不是正聊到一半？我发誓我听到了“问答游戏”什么的。

lines.en: : Y-Yes...We were going to do...something like that...
lines.zh: : 是、是的……我们本来打算……做点那种事……

lines.en: : But I don’t think we were going to ask the sort of questions you’d be interested in...
lines.zh: : 不过我想我们不会问你感兴趣的那种问题……

lines.en: : At least I hope not...
lines.zh: : 至少我希望不会……

lines.en: : Hmm okay, okay. Well don’t let me interrupt you.
lines.zh: : 嗯好吧，好吧。那就不打扰你们了。

lines.en: : Could I bother you for a glass of wine, though?
lines.zh: : 不过能麻烦你给我一杯葡萄酒吗？

lines.en: : Oh...umm...Sure.
lines.zh: : 哦……嗯……当然。

lines.en: : I’ll be right back...
lines.zh: : 我马上回来……

lines.en: scene bartwofive11
Sana walks to the other end of the counter and opens a brand new bottle of red wine, pouring it carefully into a glass.
lines.zh: Sana 走到柜台另一头，开了一瓶全新的红酒，小心地倒进杯子里。

lines.en: : Another student of yours?
lines.zh: : 又一个你的学生？

lines.en: : Another student of mine.
lines.zh: : 又一个我的学生。

lines.en: : Do you have any girls who {i}don’t{/i} work in businesses not suited for their age group?
lines.zh: : 你就没有哪个女生{i}不是{/i}在不适合她这个年纪的店里打工的吗？

lines.en: : A few. None as impressive as a porn shop, though.
lines.zh: : 有几个。不过没有一个像情趣用品店这么厉害。

lines.en: : I think that’s the first time anyone’s referred to my shop as impressive.
lines.zh: : 我想这是第一次有人把我的店说成“厉害”。

lines.en: : Thank you for your kind words. I’ll knock 500 yen off of your next fleshlight in order to thank you for them.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的美言。为了答谢，你下次买飞机杯我给你减 500 日元。

lines.en: : You truly know the way to a man’s heart, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真是太懂怎么抓住男人的心了，对吧？

lines.en: scene bartwofive12
Sana comes back a minute or two later and places a glass in front of Maki, who immediately picks it up and begins sipping away.
lines.zh: 一两分钟后 Sana 回来了，把杯子放到 Maki 面前，Maki 立刻端起来啜饮起来。

lines.en: : I...take it you two know each other?...
lines.zh: : 我……看来你们俩认识？……

lines.en: : Know each other? We’re practically inseparable.
lines.zh: : 认识？我们几乎是形影不离。

lines.en: : We’ve hung out a couple times.
lines.zh: : 我们出去玩过几次。

lines.en: : That’s...worrying.
lines.zh: : 这……让人担心。

lines.en: : What’s truly worrying is your mother, dear.
lines.zh: : 真正让人担心的是你母亲，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Is she okay?
lines.zh: : 她还好吗？

lines.en: scene bartwofive13
: I...think so? Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 我……应该还好吧？你为什么这么问？

lines.en: : Well, because she was one of my regular customers and I haven’t been seeing her much at all lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯，因为她以前是我的常客，可最近我几乎都没见到她了。

lines.en: : Sara is a regular at the porn shop?
lines.zh: : Sara 是情趣用品店的常客？

lines.en: scene bartwofive14
: Oh, please. If I had a dollar for every dildo I’ve sold that woman, I’d have enough to open two more stores.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。我卖给那女人的每根假阳具要是都能赚一美元，我早就够钱再开两家店了。

lines.en: : I’d hope that you’re profiting at least a dollar from every sex toy you sell.
lines.zh: : 我希望你每卖一件情趣玩具至少能赚一美元吧。

lines.en: : You might need to raise your prices if that’s not the case.
lines.zh: : 要不是这样的话，你大概得涨价了。

lines.en: : Umm...can we...talk about something else?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们……能聊点别的吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t really...
lines.zh: : 我真的……

lines.en: scene bartwofive15
: Oh gosh. Of course! I forgot how innocent and untainted you are. So different from your perverted mother.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪。当然可以！我都忘了你有多纯洁无瑕。跟你那个变态妈妈完全不一样。

lines.en: : This is probably why you weren’t invited out tonight, Maki.
lines.zh: : 这大概就是今晚你没被约出去的原因，Maki。

lines.en: scene bartwofive16
: Rude!
lines.zh: : 无礼！

lines.en: : Umm...to get things back on track...maybe we should do the question thing...another time?
lines.zh: : 嗯……为了回到正题……也许我们该改天……再玩问答？

lines.en: : I think we’re still fine as long as Maki agrees to not make things perverted.
lines.zh: : 只要 Maki 答应不把话题往色情上带，我觉得我们还能继续。

lines.en: : You overestimate me, good sir. Of course I'm going to make things perverted.
lines.zh: : 你太高看我了，好先生。我当然要把话题往色情上带。

lines.en: scene bartwofive17
: But go ahead and play your game, dear. I have a daughter, too, so I know when I need to take the back seat.
lines.zh: : 不过你们继续玩你们的游戏吧，亲爱的。我也有个女儿，所以我懂什么时候该退居二线。

lines.en: : You...have a daughter?...
lines.zh: : 你……有个女儿？……

lines.en: : That’s Makoto’s mom.
lines.zh: : 那是 Makoto 的妈妈。

lines.en: scene bartwofive18
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Like...class president Makoto?
lines.zh: : 就是……学生会会长 Makoto？

lines.en: : Yes, yes. Please tell me more about how impressive my daughter is. I live for it.
lines.zh: : 对，对。请再多跟我说说我女儿有多厉害吧。我靠这个活着。

lines.en: scene bartwofive19
: Well...I guess that explains why you know her a little better then...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我大概明白你为什么对她了解得深一点了……

lines.en: : For a second, I was worried you were also a...regular customer...
lines.zh: : 有那么一瞬间，我还担心你也是……常客……

lines.en: : What are you talking about? Of course he’s-
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？他当然是——

lines.en: : Okay, Sana. Question game starts now.
lines.zh: : 好了，Sana。问答游戏现在开始。

lines.en: : Ask me whatever you like.
lines.zh: : 你想问什么就问吧。

lines.en: scene bartwofive20
: Mm!
: Um...uhh...it’s kind of hard when you put me on the spot like that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……呃……你这样突然把问题抛给我，我有点答不上来……

lines.en: : Hard like a-
lines.zh: : 硬得像——

lines.en: : Maki.
lines.zh: : Maki。

lines.en: scene bartwofive21
: Umm...okay...how about this...
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧……这样吧……

lines.en: : If you had to...describe your outlook on life with...a vegetable...what vegetable would it be?
lines.zh: : 如果让你……用一种蔬菜来……描述你的人生观……你会选哪种蔬菜？

lines.en: : ...That’s your question?
lines.zh: : ……这就是你的问题？

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s the question I chose and you need to answer it or...I’ll kick you out of the bar.
lines.zh: : 对。这就是我选的问题，你必须回答，不然……我就把你赶出酒吧。

lines.en: : But then you’d be alone with the porn lady.
lines.zh: : 可那样你就得跟色情店大姐姐单独待着了。

lines.en: scene bartwofive22
: I don’t think your mother would like that very much. I'm a bad influence.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你妈妈不会太喜欢那样。我可是个坏影响。

lines.en: : Answer the question...or else.
lines.zh: : 回答问题……不然我动手了。

lines.en: : Wow, Sana. Maybe you {i}are{/i} improving your social skills? It’s not like you to put your foot down. Especially in front of other people.
lines.zh: : 哇哦，Sana。也许你{i}真的{/i}在提高社交能力了？你可不像是会坚持己见的人，尤其是在别人面前。

lines.en: : Vegetable. Tell me.
lines.zh: : 蔬菜。快说。

lines.en: : Maybe...a tomato?
lines.zh: : 大概……番茄？

lines.en: scene bartwofive23
: Wait...isn’t the tomato a fruit?
lines.zh: : 等等……番茄不是水果吗？

lines.en: : Oh, don’t even start. That’s a whole other game.
lines.zh: : 哦，别提这个。那是另一场游戏了。

lines.en: : Why a tomato?
lines.zh: : 为什么是番茄？

lines.en: : Probably because...On the outside, it pretty much always looks fine.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为……从外面看，它几乎永远是好好的。

lines.en: : But sometimes, you’ll bite into one and it'll be outright rotten.
lines.zh: : 可有的时候，你一口咬下去，里面已经烂透了。

lines.en: : That’s kind of how I look at life, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我大概是这么看待人生的。

lines.en: : Approach everything normally, but don’t be surprised if things turn out horrible all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 平常心去面对一切，但要是事情突然变得一团糟，也别太惊讶。

lines.en: : You need to get laid.
lines.zh: : 你需要找个人上床。

lines.en: scene bartwofive24
: When you put it that way...I kind of agree...
lines.zh: : 听你这么一说……我有点同意……

lines.en: : Not about the...l-laid part, though...
lines.zh: : 不过不是……上、上床那部分……

lines.en: : There’s not really any way to tell when things will go bad...
lines.zh: : 真的没什么办法预知事情什么时候会变糟……

lines.en: : Which is...one of the reasons I don’t like tomatoes.
lines.zh: : 这也是……我不喜欢番茄的原因之一。

lines.en: : Is one of the other reasons that they’re a key ingredient in-
lines.zh: : 那另一个原因是不是因为它们是……的主要原料之一——

lines.en: : Don’t...even think about it, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 想都……别想，老师……

lines.en: : Don’t think about what? Am I missing out on an inside joke here?
lines.zh: : 别想什么？我是不是错过了什么内部梗？

lines.en: : Didn’t you come here to drink?
lines.zh: : 你不是来喝酒的吗？

lines.en: : What happened to taking the back seat and letting us have our conversation?
lines.zh: : 说好的退居二线、让我们自己聊天呢？

lines.en: : This could be a breakthrough moment for Sana.
lines.zh: : 这对 Sana 来说可能是个突破性的瞬间。

lines.en: scene bartwofive25
: Good luck breaking through {i}anything{/i} with that attitude.
lines.zh: : 就凭那种态度，祝你能突破{i}什么东西{/i}吧。

lines.en: : Um...what does she mean by...breaking through {i}anything{/i}?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……她说“突破{i}什么东西{/i}”是什么意思？……

lines.en: : Did I do something wrong?...
lines.zh: : 我是不是做错什么了？……

lines.en: : Yes. Tell her, Sensei. Tell her all about what you want to break through.
lines.zh: : 没错。告诉她，老师。好好跟她说说你想突破什么。

lines.en: : It’s just some...adult humor. Don’t pay any mind to her.
lines.zh: : 那只是些……成年人的玩笑。别理她。

lines.en: scene bartwofive26
: Well...no matter what type of humor it is...I’m glad we have the same vegetable answer...
lines.zh: : 嗯……不管那是哪种玩笑……我很高兴我们选了同一种蔬菜……

lines.en: : Have you adopted the way of the tomato as well, Sana?
lines.zh: : 你也顿悟了番茄之道吗，Sana？

lines.en: : Um...I guess so?
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t really call it the way of the tomato, though...that sounds kind of silly.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会管它叫“番茄之道”……那听起来有点傻。

lines.en: : Yeah. We’ll think up a better name for it in the future.
lines.zh: : 是啊。以后我们再给它想个更好的名字。

lines.en: scene bartwofive27
: Did you...maybe want to ask me something now...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你……现在要不要问我点什么……老师？

lines.en: : It’s not much of a game if we just...stop after the vegetable...
lines.zh: : 要是我们问完蔬菜就……停了，那也算不上什么游戏了……

lines.en: Hmm...
A question for Sana.
lines.zh: 给 Sana 的问题。

lines.en: Is there anything I’ve been wanting to ask her?
lines.zh: 我有什么一直想问她的吗？

lines.en: It could be something as simple as just asking her what kind of music she likes.
lines.zh: 哪怕是“她喜欢什么音乐”这种简单的问题也行。

lines.en: But I feel like now might be a good opportunity to pry a little further into her past.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得现在也许是个好机会，可以稍微往她的过去探一探。

lines.en: Sana’s never really elaborated on her personal life or any problems but...
lines.zh: Sana 从来没有详细讲过自己的私生活或者什么烦恼，不过……

lines.en: Well, Maki is right next to us and serving as a sort of ‘block’ right now.
lines.zh: 嗯，Maki 就在我们旁边，眼下算是某种“挡板”。

lines.en: So maybe sticking with a simple question would be good for the time being?
lines.zh: 所以也许暂时还是问个简单的问题比较好？

lines.en: I can always ask her more personal things some other time.
lines.zh: 更私人的问题，改天再问也不迟。

lines.en: : How about this...
lines.zh: : 这样吧……

lines.en: : If you were magically granted the ability to play any instrument what would it be?
lines.zh: : 如果你被魔法赋予了演奏任意一种乐器的能力，你会选什么？

lines.en: : Skin flute.
lines.zh: : 皮笛。

lines.en: : Maki.
lines.zh: : Maki。

lines.en: scene bartwofive28
: I’m kind of...relieved that you chose something like that and not anything weird...
lines.zh: : 我有点……庆幸你问的是这种问题，而不是什么奇怪的东西……

lines.en: : No weird questions until at least Round-3. That’s the rule.
lines.zh: : 至少到第 3 轮之前不问奇怪的问题。这是规矩。

lines.en: : Well...I don’t understand what rule you’re talking about...but I think it would be fun to play the drums.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不知道你在说什么规矩……不过我觉得打鼓应该会很好玩。

lines.en: : The drums? Really? You seem like more of a...keyboard player than a drummer.
lines.zh: : 打鼓？真的吗？你看起来更像是……键盘手而不是鼓手。

lines.en: scene bartwofive29
: Heheh...I can see why you’d say that...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我明白你为什么会这么说……

lines.en: : But who we are on the outside doesn’t always match who we are on the inside...
lines.zh: : 可是一个人的外表并不总是和内在一致……

lines.en: : Maybe there’s a...drummer inside of me that’s just dying to come out some day?
lines.zh: : 也许我身体里住着一个……总有一天渴望爆发的鼓手？

lines.en: scene bartwofive27
: Obviously...something like that won’t ever happen...
lines.zh: : 显然……那种事是永远不会发生的……

lines.en: : But if magic were involved and...I could make the choice myself...
lines.zh: : 不过如果真的有魔法……而且我可以自己选择的话……

lines.en: : Definitely drums...
lines.zh: : 绝对是鼓……

lines.en: scene bartwofive30
: I’d also look super awesome and...badass behind a drum set...Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 而且我坐在架子鼓后面一定看起来又帅又……酷，对吧，老师？

lines.en: scene bartwofive31
: Why aren’t you saying anything?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么不说话？……

lines.en: scene black
The conversation carries on for a full hour after that.
lines.zh: 之后，这场对话又持续了整整一个小时。

lines.en: We go back and forth asking each other seemingly pointless things and slowly but surely chipping away at what makes each of us tick.
lines.zh: 我们你来我往地问着彼此一些看似毫无意义的问题，一点一点地剥开各自的内里。

lines.en: One thing I realize is that almost every single one of Sana’s answers is something I don’t expect to hear.
lines.zh: 我意识到一件事：Sana 几乎每一个答案都出乎我的意料。

lines.en: It, once again, reminds me that there really might be a lot more to her than she lets on.
lines.zh: 这再一次提醒了我，她藏起来的东西，也许真的比她表现出来的多得多。

lines.en: And hiding somewhere deep within that tiny frame of hers-
lines.zh: 而在她那副小小的身板深处——

lines.en: Lies a super awesome, badass drummer just waiting to escape.
lines.zh: 潜藏着一个超帅、超酷的鼓手，只等着破笼而出。
